title: Well-formed algebraic circuit
statement: An algebraic circuit on $n$ inputs is well formed if its gate list is nonempty and, for every index $i$ of a gate in the list, all node references used by that gate have indices strictly less than $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate at index $i$ has references below $i
